creator.identity_basis: Current explicit developer role, user-scoped invocation, exact on-disk Agent/Skill/Guideline/Prompt/Request loaded; invocation UUID is local attribution, not an external platform identity
creator.harness_evidence: get_current_session returned this session and canonical SupportIQ working directory; its title is not role proof

clock_basis: Python timezone-aware local system UTC sampled at record preparation; not exact publication time

gate.applicability: No formal product approval or acceptance gate is created or satisfied

task_context: Initial assessment; no approved Requirement, Plan, or Plan-local task
last_confirmed_boundary: Completed assessment and independently freshly validated terminal result/report/evidence after publication

observation.basis: This separate independent fresh-readback command after final publication; system UTC observation, not exact publication time

repository_effects: Own authorized records only; endpoint nonmutation checks PASS; no sandbox or continuous-event guarantee claimed
blockers: Recommendations only; no AI applicability decision
safe_continuation_prerequisites: Stop; actual Human dispositions and any separately initiated next process must independently validate current applicability
